title: Crisis-Proof Cast Iron Pan Pizza
pinned-tweaks:
* At 5,500 ft elevation in Centennial, reduce instant yeast to ''3.5 g'' for an overnight cold ferment so the dough doesn't over-proof.
* Finish on the stovetop burner over medium heat for 90 seconds if you want extra-charred leopard spotting on the bottom crust.
ingredients:
# Dough (70% Hydration)
400 | g | [[Bread Flour]] | King Arthur preferred
280 | g | [[Warm Water]] | 95°F / 35°C
10 | g | [[Fine Sea Salt]] |
4 | g | [[Instant Yeast]] |
8 | g | [[Extra-Virgin Olive Oil]] | for dough

# Assembly & Pan Coating
2 | tbsp | [[Extra-Virgin Olive Oil]] | per skillet
1 | cup | [[Crushed San Marzano Tomatoes]] | uncooked, lightly salted
225 | g | [[Low-Moisture Mozzarella]] | cubed, not pre-shredded
1/2 | tsp | [[Dried Oregano]] |
text:
!!! Directions

# ''Mix the Dough:'' Whisk [[Bread Flour]], [[Fine Sea Salt]], and [[Instant Yeast]] in a bowl. Add [[Warm Water]] and [[Extra-Virgin Olive Oil]], stirring until no dry flour remains (about 60 seconds).
# ''Proof & Divide:'' Cover tightly and rest at room temperature for 2 hours (or refrigerate 12–24 hours). Divide evenly into two oiled [[10-Inch Cast Iron Skillet]] pans, turning to coat.
# ''Pan Proof:'' Press dough toward the edges, cover, and let relax for 45–60 minutes until it fills the pan cleanly.
# ''Top to the Edge:'' Preheat oven to 500°F. Spread [[Crushed San Marzano Tomatoes]] and [[Low-Moisture Mozzarella]] all the way against the bare cast iron walls to form a caramelized //frico// cheese crown.
# ''Bake & Finish:'' Bake on the middle rack for 12–15 minutes until bubbling and golden. Check the underside with a spatula; optionally crisp over a stovetop burner for 60–90 seconds.

title: Crushed San Marzano Tomatoes
ingredients:
# Sauce Base
1 | 28-oz can | [[Whole Peeled San Marzano Tomatoes]] | drained slightly
1 | tbsp | [[Extra-Virgin Olive Oil]] |
1/2 | tsp | [[Fine Sea Salt]] |
1 | clove | [[Garlic]] | finely grated
text:
!!! Directions

# Pulse [[Whole Peeled San Marzano Tomatoes]] briefly with an [[Immersion Blender]] or crush by hand so the sauce stays slightly chunky.
# Stir in [[Extra-Virgin Olive Oil]], [[Fine Sea Salt]], and grated [[Garlic]]. Do not pre-cook before spreading onto pizza dough so the tomatoes stay bright and fresh in the oven.

title: CookLog: Crisis-Proof Cast Iron Pan Pizza (2026-10-25)
modifications: Used 3.5g instant yeast with a 16-hour fridge ferment; added sliced pickled jalapeños and hot honey drizzle after baking.
verdict: Crispiest frico edge yet; crumb was airy and light without gumminess.
next-time: Keep the 3.5g yeast adjustment for overnight fridge ferment at high altitude.
text:
!!! Tasting & Process Notes

* Checked bottom crust at minute 13 — needed 60 seconds on the front gas burner to get full browning across the center.
* Cubing the block mozzarella instead of grating prevented the cheese from burning before the dough finished baking.
